name: 6821-batchdecode-qwen3235bfp8-8gpu
parallelism: TP=8, EP=8 (set by the same flag), PP=1, DP=1. One node.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 512 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn: 1024 prompt tokens in and 1024 out, both fixed (stdev 0, min == max), temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos. No shared prefix, radix cache off.
purpose: A 235-billion-parameter chat assistant writing page-length replies for 32 concurrent users on a single eight-GPU node.
launch:
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8
tp-size: 8
enable-ep-moe: true
disable-radix-cache: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.80
chunked-prefill-size: 4096
